move: First frame / loop target. The stage: a bedroom from above, you (the dot) wide awake on the pillow, glow breathing fast. A small beach postcard sits on the nightstand.

vo: and counting sheep is too boring to help.
move: A fence grows in the bottom-left corner; sheep hop it one at a time (they swell toward you mid-hop). The next one gives up and lies down. You're still lit.

vo: Picturing a place you love works better.
move: The postcard lifts off the nightstand (tilt, shadow): a beach from above, sand and a foam line.

vo: Counting only fills a corner of your mind,
move: The postcard settles back. Only the sheep's corner stays lit; the rest of the room dims.

vo: so worries slip into the rest.
move: Worry notes slide in across the empty floor, one by one: Reply to Sam, Rent's due, Did I sound weird?, Is my job safe?

vo: But a rich scene, with sounds and smells, fills the whole room.
move: 'Rich scene': the postcard brightens. 'Fills the whole room': it grows from the nightstand until the beach covers the floor, burying the pen and the notes. The bed stays; your glow softens.

vo: In an Oxford study of people with insomnia,
move: Swap: super to the bottom. The stage glides up and splits into two small rooms: beach-filled (Pictured a calm scene) and plain (Just distracted), each with a small clock grown from its corner. Source under the stage.

vo: those who pictured a calm scene said they fell asleep faster than people told to just distract themselves.
move: Both clocks tick. The left glow goes out and its clock stops; the right keeps ticking, still lit. No numbers (the direction only).

vo: It's called imagery distraction. Here's how it works.
move: Super back to the top. The two rooms merge back into one bedroom, postcard on the nightstand, you on the pillow.

vo: Pick a calm place you love, like a beach.
move: 'Pick': the postcard lifts. 'Like a beach': it grows into the whole room, the bed fades away, and you glide off the pillow onto the sand.

vo: Feel the warm sand under your feet.
move: Footprints press into the sand behind you, one after another, as you settle.
A wave rolls up the sand toward you, leaves wet sand and slides back.
Salt spray drifts up off the water and fades.

vo: Watch the light on the water.
move: Glints shimmer in a path across the water: the one amber moment.

vo: If a worry drifts in, don't fight it.
move: A new worry note drifts onto the sand from the right: Are they mad at me? You don't move.

vo: Just walk back to the waves.
move: You glide down to the water's edge; the next wave carries the note away.

vo: See what's keeping you up with the sleep quiz in our bio,
move: The stage flips over: it's the postcard's back. Wish you were asleep · Take the sleep quiz · See what's keeping you up · To: you / Link in bio. On 'in our bio' a postmark thumps onto the stamp.
It flips back to the bedroom, you wide awake on the pillow: frame 0. The last frames fade into frame 0.
